description: Explicit checkpoint of the existing Ruby host callback fixture/schedules: scalar, buffered and streamed row/batch callbacks plus equivalent no-callback queries. Counters and exact values/metadata/cost validation run outside timed samples. The actual Rust binding uses the same Ruby callbacks.

workloads.name: host_buffered_none
workloads.sql: SELECT id, amount FROM host_items WHERE bucket BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: host_buffered_row
workloads.sql: SELECT id, bench_mix_row(amount) FROM host_items WHERE bucket BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: host_buffered_batch
workloads.sql: SELECT id, bench_mix_batch(amount) FROM host_items WHERE bucket BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: host_streamed_none
workloads.sql: SELECT id, amount FROM host_items WHERE id BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: host_streamed_row
workloads.sql: SELECT id, bench_mix_row(amount) FROM host_items WHERE id BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: host_streamed_batch
workloads.sql: SELECT id, bench_mix_batch(amount) FROM host_items WHERE id BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY id
